$comment: Desktop compatibility sweep round 3: the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1 and the 30 of next30.json (ranks 61-90; the harness at /tmp/zen-compat reads this list; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round3/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count. Not ranked: themes, Chrome Apps (Google Classroom) and organisation-login-only items (ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Mobility Print, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students).
